Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all from the fifth and final game of the five-match T20I series between Australia Women and India Women. The trophy is handed over to the stand-in skipper Tahlia McGrath and she hands it over to her teammates. Australia Women players are all smiles posing with the trophy. They win the series 4-1 and now shift focus to the three-match ODI series against Pakistan Women at home. The first game will take place on 16th January, Wednesday at 5.35 am IST (12.05 am GMT). On the other hand, India Women will be back in action in a T20I Tri-series with West Indies Women and South Africa Women. Their first match will be played on 19th January, Thursday at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT). As always, you can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Tahlia McGrath, the stand-in skipper of Australia Women, says that it is always a great battle with India and this series was also a good one. Adds that the power game is impressive to watch and credits Ashleigh Gardner and Grace Harris for their performance. Mentions that they pride themselves in playing fearless cricket and they did that. Ends by acknowledging the huge crowd that came in to watch the games.

Ashleigh Gardner is the Player of the Match and the Player of the Series. She says that she is enjoying her cricket and reaping the benefits of it on the field. Adds that Grace Harris took the pressure off her and it was easy batting with her. Shares that she does more range hitting when she is out of form and feels that it is all about maintaining the shape while hitting the ball.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that they were good with the bowl in the Powerplay but after that failed to execute the plans. Adds that there were a lot of learnings from this series and tells that the next thing for India Women is to improve their power game. Tells that the Aussie batters were clearing the fence with ease and they want that aspect to be added to their game. Ends by saying that they have Tri-series before the T20 World Cup and will try to do well and go into the tournament with good momentum.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Heather Graham is in for a flash interview. She says that it was a bit of a weird game and she is lost for words. Adds that their bowlers gave them a good start and it made it easy for her to come in and bowl. Mentions that she did not realise it was a hat-trick delivery and decided to go for the on-pace delivery. Tells that this series has been amazing for them and will give them more confidence going into the next series and then the T20 World Cup.

Earlier in the game, having put in to bat first, Australia Women lost both Beth Mooney and Phoebe Litchfield inside the first three overs. Despite both openers being back in the hut, Tahlia McGrath and Ellyse Perry kept the scoreboard ticking with a 38-run partnership. However, the departure of both batters meant Australia Women were under the pump at 67-4 near the halfway mark. Ashleigh Gardner and Grace Harris resurrected the innings with some clean hitting. Both batters notched their fifties and stitched an unbeaten 129-run stand to get Australia Women to a daunting total. In the second half of the game, their bowlers stepped up while defending the total and completed a clinical job.

Having leaked a lot of runs towards the back end of the innings, India Women needed their openers to start well and get them off to a solid start. However, they lost Smriti Mandhana in the first over and Shafali Verma followed her back into the hut soon. Harleen Deol did get off to a good start but her run-out made matters worse for India Women. After her departure, no other batter was able to get going and with the huge target in front, India Women were always facing an uphill task. Despite Deepti Sharma scoring a fifty towards the end, India Women fell short by 54 runs.

A comprehensive win for Australia Women! A clinical performance with both bat and ball sees Australia Women win this encounter and end the series with a 4-1 scoreline. While defending a challenging total, Darcie Brown set the tone early by dismissing Smriti Mandhana in the first over. They kept the pressure on by taking wickets at regular intervals which did not allow the opposition batters to gather any momentum. Deepti Sharma did trouble them towards the end by scoring a fifty but by then the match result was a mere formality. Heather Graham was the star with the ball with figures of 4 for 8 including a hat-trick from her two overs. Ashleigh Gardner chipped in with a couple of wickets while Tahlia McGrath, Annabel Sutherland and Darcie Brown took a wicket each.

OUT! TAKEN! Heather Graham gets her fourth wicket and India Women have been bowled out here. This is on a good length and outside off, Deepti Sharma skips down the track and goes for the heave, but slices it up in the air. Ashleigh Gardner from covers runs backwards and takes a nice catch. Australia Women win by 54 runs and takes the series 4-1!
Commentary.Howout: c Ashleigh Gardner b Heather Graham

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! FIFTY FOR SHARMA! She has been the lone warrior for India Women! This is a touch fuller and on leg, Deepti Sharma goes down and sweeps it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
On a length and on leg, Rajeshwari Gayakwad clips it through square leg for a single.
Full again and on off, Rajeshwari Gayakwad pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and on off, Rajeshwari Gayakwad blocks it back to the bowler.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad walks in to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! HAT-TRICK FOR GRAHAM! All the Australia Women player come in to congratulate her. She bowls this full and on middle, Renuka Singh goes back to play at it, but does so down the wrong line as the ball goes through to rattle the stumps. Australia Women one wicket away from victory now.
Heather Graham will bowl the final over.
FOUR! Nice use of the feet! This is a slower one, looped up, on middle, Deepti Sharma skips down the track, takes it on a full and hammers it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Full again and on leg, Renuka Singh eases it towards long on for one more.
Full and on off, Deepti Sharma drills it past the bowler and towards long on for one.
Short and on off, Renuka Singh cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Renuka Singh is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Tahlia McGrath gets a wicket now! Anjali Sarvani tries to go big, but holes out. Tahlia McGrath bowls a slower delivery, full and on off, Anjali Sarvani goes for the big slog, but is through the shot early and msitimes it high in the air towards deep mid-wicket where Ashleigh Gardner settles under it to take a nice catch. India Women lose their eighth.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashleigh Gardner b Tahlia McGrath

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on leg, slower too, Deepti Sharma helps it towards fine leg for one.
Short again and on middle, Deepti Sharma pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Short and on off, Deepti Sharma steers it towards point.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Anjali Sarvani sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shortish and on off, Anjali Sarvani pushes it towards covers.
Darts in full and on middle, angling in, Anjali Sarvani nudges it towards short fine leg.
Short and on off, Anjali Sarvani cuts it towards point.

FOUR! Fourth boundary of the over! This is a full toss, on middle, Deepti Sharma clips it towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder covers her ground and collects it, but as she gets up her feet touches the ropes and the replays confirms that.
Floated, full and on middle, Anjali Sarvani sweeps it over square leg for another run.
A bit short and on middle, Deepti Sharma works it through square leg for one.

FOUR! Make that three in a row! This is quicker, full and on leg, Deepti Sharma gets to the pitch of the ball and clips it towards the deep mid-wicket fence splitting the two fielders there for anothe boundary.
FOUR! Another one! This is tossed up and around middle, Deepti Sharma dances down the track and heaves it towards deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Good shot! This is short and on middle, Deepti Sharma goes down and sweeps it fine and wide of deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Full on middle, Anjali Sarvani works it to mid-wicket for a dot.
Yorker on middle Anjali Sarvani gets her bat down on time and digs it out to point for a dot.
Full outside off, Anjali Sarvani can only push it back to the bowler.
On a length and outside off, Deepti Sharma goes for a hoick across the line but gets an inside edge that rolls to fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Darcie Brown sprays this one short and down the leg side, Deepti Sharma looks to help it fine but misses.
WIDE! Darcie Brown bowls a loopy delivery wide outside off, Deepti Sharma leaves it alone. WIded.
SIX! HUGE! On a length on off, right in the slot for the batter, Deepti Sharma sits in her crease and slogs this one wide of long on for a maximum.
Fuller outside off, Deepti Sharma slogs across the line but fails to get it past mid-wicket.
Flatter, full and on middle, Deepti Sharma sweeps it through square leg for one.
FOUR! SMASHED! This is a juicy full toss, on middle, Deepti Sharma comes down the track and smashes it towards the wide long on fence for a boundary.
Flighted, full and on middle, Anjali Sarvani sweeps it uppishly but on the bounce towards deep square leg. A single is taken.
Quicker, full and on off, Anjali Sarvani steers it towards short third man.
Floated and around middle, Deepti Sharma uses her feet and and whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, short and on off, turning in, Anjali Sarvani heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Change.
Short and outside off, Deepti Sharma cuts it straight to cover for a dot.

FOUR! Ashleigh Gardner loses her radar and sprays this one on a length and sliding down the leg side, Deepti Sharma gets inside the line of the delivery and helps it past short fine leg for a boundary.
Short on off, Deepti Sharma punches it straight to point for a dot.
Short and quicker on off, Deepti Sharma cuts it short third man for a dot.
Full outside off, Deepti Sharma gets forward and drives it to cover for a dot.
Short outside off, Ashleigh Gardner cuts it straight to point for a dot.
Anjali Sarvani is the next batter in for India Women.

OUT! BOWLED! TWO IN TWO! Heather Graham bowls this one quicker and on a length on off, Radha Yadav looks to whip this one from the crease but misses. The ball takes the off stump to send India Women into further trouble.
Radha Yadav walks out to bat now.

OUT! STUMPED! Another one bites the dust! Slow and full outside off by Heather Graham, Devika Vaidya steps out to work it down the ground but fails to get any bat on it. Beth Mooney collects it cleanly and whips the bails off in a flash to send Devika Vaidya on her way back.
Commentary.Howout: st Beth Mooney b Heather Graham

Commentary.Commentary: Full on off, Deepti Sharma pushes this one towards long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Devika Vaidya uses her feet and pulls it uppishly towards deep square leg. The ball falls just short of Phoebe Litchfield and batters cross for a single.
On a length around off, Devika Vaidya looks to go through covers but gets it from the outer part of the bat towards short third man for a dot.
Low full toss outside off, Deepti Sharma eases it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower and down the leg side, Devika Vaidya gets deceived by the pace and plays her shot a bit early. The ball comes off her gloves and rolls to the right of Beth Mooney who dives and collects it.
Length delivery on middle, Deepti Sharma shuffles and clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and angling at the pads, Devika Vaidya swipes across the line towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length and quicker on off, Devika Vaidya gets on top of the bounce and punches it past backward point. Hits it wide of third man for a boundary.
On a length at the pads, Deepti Sharma gets inside and works it to fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Kim Garth bowls this one slow on a length down the leg side, Deepti Sharma looks to help it fine but misses.
Short on off, Devika Vaidya guides this one towards third man. Darcie Brown there runs around and keeps it to one.
Kim Garth (2-0-12-0) comes back into the attack.
Length delivery on middle, Devika Vaidya gets down to sweep but gets a top edge that goes high in the air towards fine leg but falls safe for a single.
On a length on middle, Deepti Sharma advances to drive but mishits it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full outside off, Deepti Sharma drives it straight to extra cover for a dot.
Floated, full around off, Devika Vaidya uses her feet to go down the ground but gets it from the inner part of the bat towards long on for a single.
Full outside off, Deepti Sharma gets down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, on a length on off, Devika Vaidya sweeps this one towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter, full and on leg, Devika Vaidya tucks it through square leg for a single.
Quicker, full and on middle, Devika Vaidya digs it back towards the bowler.
Floated, full and on off, Devika Vaidya drives it towards mid off.
Short and around off, Devika Vaidya guides it towards short third man.
Devika Vaidya walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! An excellent catch in the deep! Richa Ghosh goes back to the hut now. Australia Women players are delighted. Ashleigh Gardner bangs this short and on middle, Richa Ghosh moves back and tries to go for the pull shot, but she mistimes it a bit towards the deep mid-wicket fence. Heather Graham there keeps her eyes on the ball and times her jump to perfection to take a terrific catch close to the boundary ropes. The replay shows it is a clean catch and India Women lose half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Heather Graham b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Deepti Sharma cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
A slower one now, on a length and on off, Richa Ghosh pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Two in a row! This is full and outside off, Richa Ghosh dances down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.

FOUR! Richa Ghosh takes advantage of the Free Hit. Annabel Sutherland lands this short, on middle, sits up nicely for the batter, Richa Ghosh pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
NO BALL! On a length and outside off, Richa Ghosh looks to cut this one but misses. Annabel Sutherland has overstepped and a Free Hit to follow.
WIDE! Annabel Sutherland loses her radar and bowls this one touch short and way down the leg side, Richa Ghosh looks to help this one on the leg side but misses.
Short and at the pads, Deepti Sharma gets inside and helps it to fine leg. Gets off the mark with a single.
Good bumper by Annabel Sutherland! Bowls it short and around off, Deepti Sharma sways away and leaves it alone.
Deepti Sharma walks in to bat.

OUT! LBW! Great start for Annabel Sutherland! She gets the skipper of India Women and Australia Women are right on top here. Annabel Sutherland begins with a full delivery, around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur moves across and tries to flick it off the back foot. However, the length is not right for that shot, and she misses the ball to get rapped around the pads right in front of the stumps. There is an huge appeal for LBW, and up goes the finger. India Women four down now.
Full and on off, Harmanpreet Kaur taps it towards covers for one.
Short and on middle, Richa Ghosh pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

This is pitched up, on off, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards mid off and sets off for the run, but Richa Ghosh at the other end is looking at the ball. Both the batters are at the same end, but the fielder fumbles and allows the batter the run. It could have been another disaster for India Women.
Fuller again and on leg, angling in, Harmanpreet Kaur tickles it towards fine leg where Alana King from deep square leg runs and cuts it out.
Full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Harmanpreet Kaur welcomes Tahlia McGrath with a boundary. She bowls this short and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur waits for it and opens the face of her bat to guide it through point for a boundary.
A bit short and on leg, Richa Ghosh looks to flick it away, but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down.
Floated, full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Shortish and on middle, Richa Ghosh tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Richa Ghosh goes for the sweep, but gets a bottom edge onto the ground to the leg side.
Richa Ghosh is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! A disaster for India Women! This is short again and on off, Harleen Deol cuts it towards covers and sets off for the run, but she is sent back halfway through. She gets stuck on the pitch a bit as she turns to get back in the crease. Tahlia McGrath throws it at the keeper's end and Beth Mooney does the rest. The replay shows that Deol is short of a her crease. An unlucky end to a short but crisp knock. India Women three down now.
Alana King starts with a short delivery, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur moves back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Alana King comes on to bowl.
Fuller again and on off, Harleen Deol drills it towards long off. India Women are on 46 for two after the end of Powerplay.
FOUR! Fine shot! Darcie Brown serves this full again and around leg, Harleen Deol uses her wrists and flicks it over square leg for another boundary.
Full and on off, Harleen Deol drives it towards mid off.
Darcie Brown bangs in a bounce, on middle, Harleen Deol ducks under it. It is called a wide for height.
FOUR! Good shot! This is on a good length and on middle, Harleen Deol stays there and whips it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
On a length and around leg, Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it towards fine leg for a single.
Darcie Brown nails the yorker, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur does well to put her bat down and keeps it out.
Darcie Brown errs in her line and serves this full but down the leg, Harmanpreet Kaur misses her flick. Wided.
Harleen Deol is looking in great nick today and needs to be there with Harmanpreet Kaur.
SIX! SHOT! Floated, on a length around off, Harleen Deol shimmies down the track and frees her arms to go over long on. Clears the fence with ease and collects a maximum.
FOUR! Tossed up, full on off, Harleen Deol gets into the position early and executes the sweep to perfection. Gets it past the square leg fielder and collects a boundary.
On a length around off, Harleen Deol gets down on one knee to sweep but fails to get any bat on it and gets hit on the arm. A loud appeal but the umpire shakes her head.
Length delivery on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur works this one wide of mid-wicket and takes a single.
Harmanpreet Kaur comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ashleigh Gardner strikes straightaway! Tossed up, full outside off, Shafali Verma obliges and goes through with the swing. Gets it from the toe end of the bat and skies high in the air down to long on. Annabel Sutherland there settles under it and completes the catch. Both openers back in the hut for India Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Annabel Sutherland b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: On a length outside off, Harleen Deol punches this one off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Ashleigh Gardner comes into the attack now.
Slower and on a length on middle, Shafali Verma advances and can only push it to the left of the bowler for a dot.
FOUR! Streaky boundary for Shafali Verma! Full and on middle by Kim Garth, Shafali Verma goes for a hoick across the line but gets a thick outside edge that flies past the keeper for a boundary.
On a length and at the pads, Harleen Deol flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle by Kim Garth, Shafali Verma uses her feet and drives it back past the bowler towards long on for a single.
Full outside off, Shafali Verma knocks this one towards backward point for a dot.
On a length and around off, Shafali Verma looks to cut this one on the off side but misses.
Short and on off, Harleen Deol ducks under it and leaves it alone.
Bumper on off by Darcie Brown, Harleen Deol ducks under it and lets it go.
Length delivery outside off, Harleen Deol chips this one uppishly towards mid-wicket for a dot.
On a length around off, Harleen Deol looks to work it on the off side but misses.

DROPPED! Grace Harris has put it down! On a length outside off, Shafali Verma looks to work this one on the leg side and closes her bat face early. Gets a leading edge and it skies high in the air towards point. Grace Harris there settles under it and it bursts through her hands.
Fullish outside off and going away, Shafali Verma opens the bat face but fails to get it past short third man.
Short and outside off, Shafali Verma rolls her wrist and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length around off, Shafali Verma punches it uppishly towards mid off for a dot.
FOUR! Short and punished by Shafali Verma! Cutter, short and outside off, Shafali Verma lets the ball come to her and pulls this one past mid on. HIts it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
On a length and around off, Shafali Verma blocks this one towards backward point for a dot.
Short and outside off, Shafali Verma advances and cuts it along the ground but straight to Darcie Brown at point.
WIDE! Kim Garth loses her radar and bowls this one short and wide outside off, Shafali Verma leaves it alone.
Kim Garth starts with a good-length delivery outside off, goes away after pitching, Shafali Verma goes for the straight drive but misses.
Kim Garth to bowl from the other end.
Full on off, Harleen Deol taps it to cover for a dot.
FOUR! SHOT! Full and outside off, swinging away from the batter, Harleen Deol gets forward and frees her arms to drive this one past backward point. Gets off the mark with a boundary.
Harleen Deol walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! On a length and at the pads by Darcie Brown, Smriti Mandhana gets in line of the delivery and flicks this one towards square leg. Fails to keeper her shot along the ground and hits it straight to Grace Harris there who makes no mistake. Tahlia McGrath had just moved Grace Harris from slip to square leg and gets the reward.
Commentary.Howout: c Grace Harris b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Smriti Mandhana punches this one to cover for a dot.
Short of a length on middle, nips back in, Smriti Mandhana pushes this one off the back foot towards extra cover for a dot.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana is up and running! Darcie Brown starts with a length delivery outside off, Smriti Mandhana picks the length early and pulls this one through square leg for a boundary.
